description: Source file defining the main application model for an iOS app, managing state, network connections, capabilities, and interactions such as camera, notifications, deep links, and gateway requests.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: Main application model managing app state, connections, capabilities, and user interactions.

methods.name: setScenePhase
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle events, managing background/foreground states and network reconnections.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice wake functionality, considering interactions with talk mode.

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode, updating user defaults and notifying the gateway.

methods.name: requestLocationPermissions
methods.description: Requests location permissions based on specified mode, returning success status.

methods.name: setSelectedAgentId
methods.description: Sets the selected agent ID, updating gateway settings and session keys.

methods.name: setGlobalWakeWords
methods.description: Configures global wake words that trigger voice wake.

methods.name: refreshGatewayOverviewIfConnected
methods.description: Refreshes app branding and agent list if connected to the gateway.

methods.name: buildCapabilityRouter
methods.description: Constructs a routing table associating command strings with handler functions for node invoke commands.

methods.name: handleWatchInvoke
methods.description: Processes incoming watch-related commands, handling status refresh and notification sending.

methods.name: locationMode
methods.description: Retrieves current location permission mode from user defaults.

methods.name: isLocationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether precise location is enabled; always returns true in current implementation.

methods.name: decodeParams
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into a specified Decodable type, with error handling.

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes an Encodable object into a JSON string.

methods.name: isCameraEnabled
methods.description: Checks if camera access is enabled, defaulting to true if setting is unset.

methods.name: triggerCameraFlash
methods.description: Increments the camera flash nonce to trigger hardware flash.

methods.name: showCameraHUD
methods.description: Displays a camera heads-up display (HUD) with text and optional auto-hide timeout.

methods.name: mainSessionKey
methods.description: Generates the main session key based on current selected agent and defaults.

methods.name: chatSessionKey
methods.description: Returns session key aligned with the main session key for chat purposes.

methods.name: activeAgentName
methods.description: Resolves the human-readable name of the currently active agent.

methods.name: connectToGateway
methods.description: Initiates connection to a gateway with specified parameters and options, setting up sessions and reconnection behavior.

methods.name: applyGatewayConnectConfig
methods.description: Applies a connection configuration object and starts gateway connection loops.

methods.name: disconnectGateway
methods.description: Performs proper disconnection and cleanup of current gateway sessions and state.

methods.name: prepareForGatewayConnect
methods.description: Resets internal state for initiating a new gateway connection based on URL and ID.

methods.name: shouldStartOperatorGatewayLoop
methods.description: Determines if the operator gateway loop should be started, based on stored tokens and credentials.

methods.name: hasStoredGatewayRoleToken
methods.description: Checks if a stored role token exists for a specified role.

methods.name: shouldStartOperatorGatewayLoop (static)
methods.description: Static decision logic for whether to initiate the operator gateway loop, based on credentials and token presence.

methods.name: clearingBootstrapToken
methods.description: Returns a modified gateway connect config with bootstrap token cleared, for security.

methods.name: currentGatewayReconnectAuth
methods.description: Gets current auth tokens for gateway reconnection, falling back to defaults if needed.

methods.name: clearPersistedGatewayBootstrapTokenIfNeeded
methods.description: Removes bootstrap token from persistent storage after successful bootstrap connection.

methods.name: handleSuccessfulBootstrapGatewayOnboarding
methods.description: Handles post-connection steps after successful bootstrap onboarding, including starting operator loop and requesting notifications.

methods.name: refreshBackgroundReconnectSuppressionIfNeeded
methods.description: Evaluates and manages whether background reconnection should be suppressed based on lease expiration.

methods.name: shouldPauseReconnectLoopInBackground
methods.description: Decides if reconnection loops should be paused when app is backgrounded.

methods.name: startOperatorGatewayLoop
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous task that manages the operator WebSocket connection with retries, disconnection handling, and callback invocations.

methods.name: startNodeGatewayLoop
methods.description: Begins the main reconnect loop managing node gateway WebSocket session, with handling for errors, pairing, and connection state.

methods.name: shouldRequestOperatorApprovalScope
methods.description: Determines whether operator approval scope should be requested based on tokens, passwords, and stored scopes.

methods.name: makeOperatorConnectOptions
methods.description: Constructs connection options for the operator gateway, including role, scopes, and client details.

methods.name: legacyClientIdFallback
methods.description: Provides fallback client ID when connection errors indicate a need for different client parameters.

methods.name: isOperatorConnected
methods.description: Asynchronous check whether the operator session is currently connected.

methods.name: refreshShareRouteFromGateway
methods.description: Requests session list from the gateway to update sharing-related connection details for relay setup.

methods.name: runSharePipelineSelfTest
methods.description: Performs a test of the share pipeline by constructing a deep link and simulating a share event.

methods.name: refreshLastShareEventFromRelay
methods.description: Updates the last share event text from stored relay settings.

methods.name: recordShareEvent
methods.description: Stores and refreshes the last share event log.

methods.name: reloadTalkConfig
methods.description: Triggers reloading of voice talk mode configuration.

methods.name: onNodeGatewayConnected
methods.description: Post-connection handler to register push notifications and resume pending actions.

methods.name: resumePendingForegroundNodeActionsIfNeeded
methods.description: Pulls and executes any pending foreground node actions awaiting execution after reconnect.

methods.name: applyPendingForegroundNodeActions
methods.description: Executes a list of node actions and acknowledges them.

methods.name: ackPendingForegroundNodeAction
methods.description: Sends acknowledgment for a processed node action.

methods.name: handleWatchQuickReply
methods.description: Processes quick replies from watch events, forwarding or dropping as appropriate.

methods.name: flushQueuedWatchRepliesIfConnected
methods.description: Forwards all queued watch reply events if the gateway is connected.

methods.name: forwardWatchReplyToAgent
methods.description: Sends a watch reply message through the agent request system.

methods.name: makeWatchReplyAgentMessage
methods.description: Creates a textual message describing a watch reply for forwarding.

methods.name: handleSilentPushWake
methods.description: Handles silent push notifications to potentially reconnect sessions based on payload content.

methods.name: handleBackgroundRefreshWake
methods.description: Handles background refresh events, attempting reconnection if appropriate.

methods.name: handleSignificantLocationWakeIfNeeded
methods.description: Manages location-based wake events, throttling re-connections and requesting location updates.

methods.name: updateAPNsDeviceToken
methods.description: Updates stored APNs device token and triggers registration with gateway.

methods.name: registerAPNsTokenIfNeeded
methods.description: Registers the stored APNs token with the gateway if not already registered or relay transport is used.

methods.name: fetchPushRelayGatewayIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves push relay gateway identity data, decoding JSON response.

methods.name: isSilentPushPayload
methods.description: Checks whether a push notification payload is silent (content-available).

methods.name: hasContentAvailable
methods.description: Helper to determine if

methods.name: hasContentAvailable
methods.description: Helper to determine if push payload has content-available flag.

methods.name: makePushWakeAttemptID
methods.description: Creates a unique identifier for a push wake attempt.

methods.name: openclawPushKind
methods.description: Type or category of push notification for OpenClaw.

methods.name: waitForGatewayConnection
methods.description: Pauses execution until the gateway connection is established.

methods.name: reconnectGatewaySessionsForSilentPushIfNeeded
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect gateway sessions triggered by silent push.

methods.name: refreshWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches updated wake words from the gateway and updates preferences.

methods.name: isGatewayHealthMon
methods.description: Checks the current health status of the gateway.
